facts.text: UC480_Camera is the uc480-supported camera class; its constructor sets the trigger mode off and opens the camera
close releases the image memory and exits the camera; a second close without force returns
grab_image starts a capture sequence and returns get_captured_image's array(s)
get_captured_image returns one 2-D array or a tuple of arrays and stops live video
set_trigger accepts 'off', 'software' or 'hardware' and the hardware edges 'rising' or 'falling'
get_trigger_level returns the hardware trigger status; a value of 0 means the signal is low
set_trigger_delay takes a time Quantity in microseconds and get_trigger_delay returns microseconds
gamma has the range 1.0 to 10.0 and is stored as an integer percentage
exposure is read and written in milliseconds; a float value passed to the setter is milliseconds
The exposure range is queried from the camera at run time
The auto-* Facets read and write one uc480 auto parameter
auto_gain, auto_sensor_gain, auto_exposure, auto_sensor_exposure, auto_whitebalance, auto_sensor_whitebalance, auto_framerate and auto_sensor_framerate are the auto-* Facets
bytes_per_line, width, height and trigger_mode are read-only properties
start_live_video and stop_live_video start and stop continuous acquisition; live video uses the off trigger mode
The UC480 page instructs installing the Thorlabs uc480 API, adding the uc480 DLL to PATH, and running pip install pywin32 nicelib
